findings.title: Dynamic PowerShell code execution
findings.description: Dynamic evaluation can make a script harder to inspect and may enable downloaded or constructed code to run.

findings.title: Network retrieval combined with code execution
findings.description: The same file contains both a network retrieval pattern and a dynamic execution pattern. This combination merits review and is not by itself proof of malicious intent.

evidence.snippet: Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process -ExecutionPolicy Unrestricted -Force; Invoke-Expression (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://github.com/azurejoga/Aurora-Windows-Optimizer/raw/aurora/installer.ps1" -UseBasicParsing).Content  …  Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process -ExecutionPolicy Unrestricted -Force; Invoke-Expression (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://github.com/azurejoga/Aurora-Windows-Optimizer/raw/aurora/installer.ps1" -UseBasicParsing).Content
